note: Each mutant was applied to the committed source and built with `lake build VE.Scope.Examples`, then the source was restored. `fixtures_with_proofs_bypassed`: the mutated definitions compiled with lean/VE/Scope/Examples.lean in a scratch file (never committed) without List.lean's proofs, so the fixtures run; an unmutated control raised no error.

mutants.name: run-depth-at-least
mutants.claim: the run governs only items of the first item's depth (sub-bullets are not governed: F2′)

mutation.from: (if x.item == some d then x.id :: runFrom d xs else runFrom d xs)
mutation.to: (if x.item.any (d ≤ ·) then x.id :: runFrom d xs else runFrom d xs)

mutants.name: continues-ignores-midline
mutants.claim: a mid-line continuation keeps the run going (F2)

mutation.from: def continues (d : Nat) (x : Unit) : Bool := x.item.any (d ≤ ·) || x.midLine
mutation.to: def continues (d : Nat) (x : Unit) : Bool := x.item.any (d ≤ ·)

mutants.name: lead-not-required
mutants.claim: a list reach needs a lead-in that ends with ":" (F2″, NotALeadIn)

mutants.name: odd-indent-item
mutants.claim: an odd indentation is not an item (spec 1.2)

mutation.from: | some _ => if (f - ls) % 2 == 0 then some ((f - ls) / 2) else none

mutants.name: para-counts-every-newline
mutants.claim: para counts blank lines only (L1, L1-p)

mutation.from: if c == nl then (arr, if blank then cnt + 1 else cnt, true)
mutation.to: if c == nl then (arr, cnt + 1, true)

mutants.name: marker-without-space
mutants.claim: a list marker needs its space (`*x` is not an item)
